title: arenaria fontqueri subsp. hispanica
intro: Arenaria fontqueri subsp. hispanica, commonly known as the Spanish sandwort, is a plant species in the Caryophyllaceae family, native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spanish sandwort include soothing sore throats, reducing inflammation, and aiding in the treatment of bronchitis and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
